title: No clocks
description: This mod removes all clocks from Minecraft, so you can’t craft or use them to track the time of day. You have to rely on the sky or your instincts to know when night is coming.
body: No Clocks deletes the clock item and its crafting recipe, so players can’t monitor day–night cycles underground or in caves. Villagers won’t trade them, chests won’t generate them, and you can’t use them in item frames to tell time. It makes mining riskier, adventuring unpredictable, and forces players to pay attention to sunlight instead of relying on a simple tool.
